title: stir_shaken Module
content_markdown: This module adds support for implementing STIR/SHAKEN (RFC 8224, RFC 8588) Authentication and Verification services in OpenSIPS.
overview: This module adds support for implementing STIR/SHAKEN (RFC 8224, RFC 8588) Authentication and Verification services in OpenSIPS.

exported_parameters.name: auth_date_freshness
exported_parameters.description:
The maximum number of seconds that the value in the Date header field can be older than the current time.

This parameter is only relevant for the stir_shaken_auth() function.

exported_parameters.name: verify_date_freshness
exported_parameters.description:
The maximum number of seconds that the value in the Date header field can be older than the current time. Also, if the _iat_ value in the PASSporT is different than the Date value, but remains within the permitted interval, it will be used in the verification process (for the reconstructed PASSporT) instead of the Date value.

If the require_date_hdr parameter is set to not required and the Date header is missing, the _iat_ value will be used for this check instead.

This parameter is only relevant for the stir_shaken_verify() function.

exported_parameters.name: ca_list
exported_parameters.description: Path to a file containing trusted CA certificates for the verifier. The certificates must be in PEM format, one after another.

exported_parameters.name: ca_dir
exported_parameters.description: Path to a directory containing trusted CA certificates for the verifier. The certificates in the directory must be in hashed form, as described in the openssl documentation for the Hashed Directory Method.

exported_parameters.name: crl_list
exported_parameters.description: Path to a file containing certificate revocation lists (CRLs) for the verifier.

exported_parameters.name: crl_dir
exported_parameters.description: Path to a directory containing certificate revocation lists (CRLs) for the verifier. The CRLs in the directory must be in hashed form, as described in the openssl documentation for the Hashed Directory Method.

exported_parameters.name: e164_strict_mode
exported_parameters.description: Require a leading "+" to be present in the originating/destination SHAKEN identity, on top of mandating an E.164 telephone number by default. Additionally, require the URI to be either a tel URI or a sip / sips URI with the user=phone parameter.

exported_parameters.name: e164_max_length
exported_parameters.description: This parameter allows the 15-digit number length restriction of the E.164 format to be bypassed. Especially useful in scenarios where various telephony number prefixes are in use, causing some numbers to exceed the standard maximum length.

exported_parameters.name: require_date_hdr
exported_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the Date header is mandatory when doing verification with the stir_shaken_verify() function.

A value of 1 means required and 0 not required.

If the parameter is set to "not required" but the Date header is present in the message, the header value will be used as normally to check the freshness (as configured in the verify_date_freshness parameter). If the Date header is indeed missing, the value of the _iat_ claim in the PASSporT will be used instead.

exported_functions.name: stir_shaken_auth

parameters.name: attest
parameters.description: value of the 'attest' claim to be included in the PASSporT.

parameters.name: origid
parameters.description: value of the 'origid' claim to be included in the PASSporT. Treated by the module as an opaque string.

parameters.name: cert
parameters.description: the X.509 certificate used to compute the signature, in PEM format.

parameters.name: pkey
parameters.description: the private key used to compute the signature, in PEM format.

parameters.name: x5u
parameters.description: value of the 'x5u' claim to be included in the PASSporT. Treated by the module as an opaque string.

parameters.name: orig
parameters.description: telephone number to be used as the originating identity in the PASSporT. If missing, this value will be derived from the SIP message.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: telephone number to be used as the destination identity in the PASSporT. If missing, this value will be derived from the SIP message.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: name of an output variable to store the Identity header or the following flags: req (append to current request), rpl (append to all replies). If missing, appended to current request.

return_values.condition: Failed to derive identity from SIP message because the URI is not a telephone number
Date header value is older than local policy for freshness
The current time or Date header value does not fall within the certificate validity

exported_functions.description: This function performs the steps of an authentication service. Before calling this function though, you must ensure: authority - the server is authoritative for the identity in question; authentication - the originator is authorized to claim the given identity.

exported_functions.name: stir_shaken_verify

parameters.name: cert
parameters.description: the X.509 certificate used to verify the signature, in PEM format.

parameters.name: err_code
parameters.description: output variable that will store the SIP response code associated with an eventual error of the verification process.

parameters.name: err_reason
parameters.description: output variable that will store the SIP response reason phrase associated with an eventual error of the verification process.

parameters.name: orig
parameters.description: telephone number to be used as the originating identity in the verification prcess. If missing, this value will be derived from the SIP message.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: telephone number to be used as the destination identity in the verification process. If missing, this value will be derived from the SIP message.

return_values.condition: No Identity or Date header found

exported_functions.description: This function performs the steps of an verification service.

exported_functions.name: stir_shaken_check
exported_functions.description: This function checks the Identity header in order to validate the STIR/SHAKEN information in terms of format. It detects issues such as: missing or badly formated PASSporT claims, unsupported extensions etc.

exported_functions.name: stir_shaken_check_cert

parameters.name: cert
parameters.description: the X.509 certificate to check, in PEM format.

exported_functions.description: This function checks if the current time falls within the given certificate's validity period.

exported_functions.name: stir_shaken_disengagement

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token provided by the authority during outage.

exported_functions.description: This function add P-Identity-Bypass header with token value at the end of SIP headers.

exported_mi_functions.name: stir_shaken:ca_reload
exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _stir_shaken_ca_reload_.

Reload the file containing trusted CA certificates for the verifier and the directory containing trusted CA certificates for the verifier.

exported_mi_functions.name: stir_shaken:crl_reload
exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _stir_shaken_crl_reload_.

Reload the file containing certificate revocation lists (CRLs) for the verifier and the directory containing certificate revocation lists for the verifier.
